capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Audi US 2024 release: 77 kWh net. Same 82/77 pack in 2022-2026 (Wikipedia). Applied to 2025: same hardware as the 2024 Q4 55 page, no change reported for North America.

preconditioning.notes: Audi US 2024 release (via InsideEVs): the route planner prioritises DC fast chargers and will thermally precondition the battery before charging. A manual control is not described (low confidence). Applied to 2025: same hardware as the 2024 Q4 55 page, no change reported for North America.

dc_max_kw.notes: Cars.com 2025: Q4 e-tron up to 175 kW, 10-80 % in 28 min (not trim-specific; Audi US spec page for the Q4 45 agrees per search result).

ac_max_kw.notes: Audi US 2024 release (via InsideEVs): 11 kW onboard charger, full recharge overnight (up to 12 h). Applied to 2025: same hardware as the 2024 Q4 55 page, no change reported for North America.
